decisions.reason: Defines paste_image/paste_file with (2),(3) before extension until free, unions same-batch with live attachments, scopes rename to paste path before record creation, keeps drop/picker names verbatim.
Names composer snapshot occurrences as authoritative and explains records.delete fires on a momentary empty snapshot while the attachment is live; includes same-batch union of in-flight assignments.

Uses captured x-cache HIT/age 178 stale 0.2.9 response and the current-chip displaying the fetched tag; gives semantic rule: update only when remote strictly newer, else show running PLUGIN_VERSION, never an older tag.

Tests cover same-batch and cross-batch distinct names, live occurrence blocking names with the records cache retired, drop/picker names unchanged, plus stale/equal and newer remote tag chip cases with concrete expected names.

Requires package.json/PLUGIN_VERSION lockstep in lib/client.js, node --check plus behavioral regressions, and re-install/re-fetch of the bundle with browser hard refresh; explicitly notes no host-side update endpoint.
